evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never framed the 10–15 minute time box or asked for explicit agreement before diving into details. Went straight to verifying address and asking about parking.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Rep confirmed: address (219 Harper St, Irving), home size (2500 sq ft, two story, four bedrooms), destination (1105 Leesy Lane, Flower Mound, two story, 5000 sq ft, five bedrooms). Moving day never explicitly asked.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked. Rep never asked 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.packing_services: Never offered. Rep asked about boxes the customer would be moving, not whether Einstein would pack for them.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Asked in the form of 'A typical box count for your home size would be 140 to 180 boxes. Do you feel that you fall within that range?' Customer clarified they have minimal boxes (5–10 max).
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Provided a typical range (5 movers, 2 trucks, 7–8 hours for a 2500 sq ft home) and personalized it to the customer's lighter load (2 trucks, 4 movers, 4.5–5.5 hours). Estimated cost: $2,222. Also provided alternative: 3 movers, 1 truck, 7 hours = $2,121.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Fully delivered: hourly rate ($101/hour per mover), what's included (gas, truck, taxes, insurance, tools, pads), 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments, no hidden fees (no credit card fees, service fees, disassemble/reassembly fees). Rep: 'The best part is that there's no hidden fees of any type.'
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked 'Does that feel fair?' Rep moved directly into discussing factors affecting move time and prep work.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Fully delivered. Rep: 'Finally, we have on time guarantee we value your time. So, if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Fully delivered. Rep: 'We will provide up to 2000 dollars per move. That is to repair, replace and reimburse for your items.' Also clarified: 'you're not paying on top of that' (built into rate, no add-on).
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Did not close the loop with a genuine 'Does that put those to rest?' after delivering the Two Promises. Rep transitioned into liability waiver discussion for the Peloton bike without confirming the promises resolved concerns.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. No version of 'What's still concerning you about this move?' Rep ended with only logistical details about sending quote and clarifying no deposit needed.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep said 'I'll send it over and in case if you wanted to proceed then feel free to let us know' and 'if ever you still have questions, then feel free to give us a call.' This is a soft, open-ended conditional, not an explicit 'Would you like our help with your move?'
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Yes. Rep: 'And yup, I'll send it over and in case if you wanted to proceed then feel free to let us know. Anyway, there's no deposit required, no reen securing your spot.' (Interpreted as rate-lock / no-deposit framing, though slightly garbled in transcript.)
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: None. No date, phone number, arrival window, crew size, addresses, or crew notes confirmed. Rep only offered to send quote and invited customer to follow up if interested.

top_strength: Rep delivered comprehensive pricing transparency and both key promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) with clear, credible framing, and confidently handled customer questions about truck size, mover flexibility, and insurance coverage.
coaching_note: Open with the time-boxed quid pro quo ('10–15 minutes, you walk away with a quote you can depend on—does that sound good?'), ask their agenda for concerns before diving into logistics, and close every section with a genuine check-in; this call skipped the final concerns check and explicit ask entirely, leaving the booking unconfirmed and the customer unsure whether to say yes.
